# AI assistants that may not author, commit or co-author a commit on main
# (maintainer's policy of 2026-11-23). Every identity not matched here passes:
# people, code-quality bots, dependency and release bots, and this repository's
# workflow bots such as autofix@auto-code-scanning.invalid.
#
# One Python regular expression per line, matched case-insensitively with
# re.search against the name and, separately, the address of each author,
# committer and Co-authored-by line. Lines starting with '#' are ignored.
# Read by check.py, check_text.py and the Contributor Identities workflow; see
# CONTRIBUTING.md.
#
# Names that are also common human names (Claude, Jules, Devin, Kiro) match only
# as the whole name, with an assistant suffix (Claude Code, claude-agent,
# ClaudeCodeBot, kiro-agent[bot]) or as the assistant's own account. So a person
# called Claude Martin, Jean-Claude Dupont or Jules Verne passes, and so does an
# address such as claude.martin@ or jules@. A suffix after a space counts only
# for Claude and only when it is not also a surname (Claude Code, not Claude Dev).
#
# Boundaries are letters only: (?<![a-z]) and (?![a-z]). Python's \b counts '_'
# and digits as word characters, so \bcodex\b would let codex_cli, codex2 or
# Codex_Bot through. A name is still not matched inside a longer word (Claudette,
# philanthropic, cursory). Run-together suffixes (CodexBot, geminicli,
# ClaudeCodeBot) are matched however many follow one another.

# Vendors and assistants, in the name or the address
(?<![a-z])(?:anthropic|codex|cursor|gemini|grok|xai|aider)(?:code|bot|agent|ai|cli|assistant|connector|dev|app)*(?![a-z])
# Names that never occur inside an ordinary word: match anywhere
openai
chatgpt
copilot
antigravity

# Assistants whose name is also a person's name.
# The whole name (never an address, which holds '@'): Claude, Kiro Agent, claude2.
^(?:claude|jules|devin|kiro)(?:[-_ ]?(?:code|bot|agent|ai|cli|assistant))*(?:[-_ .]?\d[\d.]*)?$
# With at least one suffix, in a name or an address: claude-code, ClaudeCodeBot,
# kiro_agent@example.org, jules.bot@example.org.
(?<![a-z])(?:claude|jules|devin|kiro)(?:[-_.]?(?:code|bot|agent|ai|cli|assistant|connector|dev|app))+(?![a-z])
# Claude with a suffix after a space, inside a longer name: Claude Code Bot.
(?<![a-z])claude(?:\s+(?:code|bot|agent|ai|cli|assistant|connector))+(?![a-z])
# GitHub app and bot accounts, also inside a noreply address: claude[bot],
# 123+kiro-agent[bot]@users.noreply.github.com.
(?<![a-z])(?:claude|jules|devin|kiro)(?:[-_.]?(?:code|bot|agent|ai|cli|assistant|connector|dev|app))*\[bot\]
google-labs-jules
devin-ai-integration
@devin\.ai$
@cognition\.ai$
@kiro\.dev$

# Model names
(?<![a-z])(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable)(?![a-z])
(?<![a-z])gpt[-_ .]?\d
